# Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta3

## Fixed

- Fixed Custom Area overlays not appearing when the card initializes before Custom Area sensor attributes are ready.
- Custom Area entities are now discovered from the selected mower device via their Navimower Entity Registry unique IDs instead of requiring polygon state attributes during the initial lookup.
- Custom Area polygons are validated at render time and refreshed as Home Assistant state updates arrive.

## Custom Areas

Custom Areas retain the visual controls introduced in beta2: show/hide, color, fill opacity, and border width, with the Gate Area visual style used by default.
